stock.description: Established in 2002 and headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, Hong Kong ChaoShang Group Limited operates as an investment holding company, conducting a range of business activities across the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. The company's diverse operations are structured into several segments, including trading, money lending and factoring, finance leasing, and various financial services. Its trading division deals in products such as electronic goods, seafood, frozen food, methanol, and mould. Financial offerings extend to factoring, entrusted loans, finance leasing, and sale-leaseback services. Additionally, the group provides a comprehensive suite of financial solutions, encompassing consultancy, securities brokerage, underwriting, placing, margin financing, and asset management. The firm was formerly recognized as Noble Century Investment Holdings Limited, adopting its current name in August 2019.
